Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I did 'cheap' grills for years. Debatable whether I wasted my money, but of course none of the grills lasted long. This is my second 'well built' grill and I won't go back to the cheap stuff. I like the built in hanging tank weight scale. Weight is a better way to judge remaining fuel than pressure. I don't yet know the scale's accuracy, but it seems to be 'close enough'.
The grill has 3 flavor plates but only two burners. The central plate is indirectly heated. If you fill the grill with burgers, the central patties may cook slower. On the other hand, there are times indirect heat from both sides is exactly what you want. So I'm not knocking it so much as pointing it out.  My only gripe isn't the grill, but the official Weber accessory cover. It is a pain to fiddle with multiple velcro spots - and they may not hold anyway in a brisk wind. I'm going to add grommets and bungie cords - right now I'm using a couple joined rubber trucking straps hooked to the bottom rack and going over the top.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love it!  Was really easy to put together.  Cooks evenly - once we figured out how to moderate the temperature, lol!  We are also very surprised by the propane gas usage.  We swear that we're going to run out the next time we use it, but it's been 3 times now.  Just love it!!!  Best part is the 10 year warranty!!!  Love the sapphire blue too - didn't want boring black!  Totally worth the investment!!!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this a few months ago. I bought the 2 burner because it had more BTU's per burner than the 3 burner, 2 @ 26k = 13k per. vs 3 @30k = 10k per. I'm sure the 3 burner is fine, I just like a heavy char that's cooked medium . Easier to do with more BTU"s. Plenty big enough for a single person that does grill for 3 at times. Preheat will go well over 500 degrees. Pricey but no need to look further in my mind.
Results.Title: Happy Happy

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
The grill arrived on time and the shipping box was in great shape. Amazon sent a person to assemble it, who did so and left without telling me that the one leg assembly was badly damaged. The assembler had to leave out two bolts because of the damage.
That being said, I contacted Weber who overnighted two replacement parts, and Amazon credited my card to make things right.
Results.Title: Arrived damaged

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a few months ago and use it a few times a week. I bought it mostly for its size, I didn’t want anything to to big sine I live on the 2nd floor. This grill holds temperature very well! Even if its windy you can account for the drop in temp to hold lower but be steady. Assembly was missing a nut for the propane rack but I had a spare. Overall very happy with this grill but it is smaller for 4-6 people.
Results.Title: Good Condo/Appartment style grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After purchasing many of the gas grills out there I finally got a Weber. Outstanding. Well worth the price as the quality and cooking results far outmatch other grills. By the way,  the Weber charcoal grills are great too!
Results.Title: First Time For a Weber!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
